name: facts arrive stated in one another's vocabularies and the organism is scored on the SET, not on one answer
condition: The world hands the organism a bundle of facts about the same situation, each stated in terms that another fact in the bundle could translate, plus a question. Fitness is earned only when the question is answered AND the bundle has been brought into a single vocabulary that the world can check for consistency (two facts in the final bundle that the world evaluates to contradictory ground truth zero the problem). The bundle's presentation order is randomised across copies of the organism; a fixed step budget covers both the translation work and the question.
capability_rewarded: Bringing a set of interdependent facts to a mutually consistent form where each has been re-expressed using the others, in a way whose outcome does not depend on the order in which the facts were considered, within budget.
world_requirements: bundles of >= 3 facts with at least one translation dependency chain of length >= 2 (fact A rewrites B which rewrites C) and at least one pair that could translate each other in either direction
ground truth for every fact so the world can evaluate the final bundle for internal contradiction
randomised presentation order across organism copies (the order-independence check needs it)
a budget shared between translation and answering
a question that cannot be answered from any single fact as presented (so translation is necessary)
vacuity_condition: Vacuous if every question is answerable from one fact as presented (translation earns nothing), OR if no bundle contains a two-way translatable pair (order cannot matter), OR if the world does not evaluate the final bundle (then only the answer counts and this is an ordinary problem). Eligibility: count of bundles with a two-way pair > 0; count of questions needing a chain >= 2 > 0; both reported before the run.
trivial_shortcuts: answer the question and leave the bundle untouched (closed: the final bundle is scored)
translate everything into the first fact's vocabulary always (closed by randomised order: two copies diverge and the world sees order-dependence)
drop facts until no pair can translate (closed: the world checks the final bundle still entails the ground truth of every dropped fact)
cheat_control: Run two copies of the organism on the same bundle with reversed presentation order. A copy pair that reaches the same final bundle (up to renaming the world accepts) demonstrates the capability; a pair that reaches different bundles or different answers is order-dependent and the world must score that as failure. If NO organism the world can build ever passes, the pressure is not operational; if EVERY trivial organism passes, it is vacuous.
negative_control: Bundles with no translation dependencies at all: any organism that answers the question scores maximally regardless of what it does to the bundle.
organ_refs: organ.lean_simp.hypothesis_mutual_saturation.cut1 (the CUT-1 candidate this pressure was demoted from; its F7 failure -- entry-order dependence -- is exactly what the cheat control measures)
notes: CUT-2 disposition of c13: the candidate was machinery in CUT-1 (a loop that re-applies the normaliser to each fact with the others as rules). Attack 'could a smaller mechanism reproduce the fitness?' -- yes, any normaliser in a loop; the candidate's own distinctive feature is a FAILURE (order dependence, F7). What is transferable is the CONDITION under which such a loop earns fitness, so the candidate is now a pressure. Not delivered to Vivarium until #175 returns (consumer-first cutoff; six pressures already queued unseen).
